title: Soul Feast #52: What’s Real? Reverence
excerpt: Are you making choices in love or fear?
bodyHtml:
Are you making choices in love or fear? Take this self-assessment today to find out.

In this Soul Feast, Gary deepens the “What’s Real?” exploration, turning toward reverence – the awareness that life in all its forms is precious, valuable, and sacred. Beyond appearances, reverence opens us to the essence of others, ourselves, and the world around us.

Reverence is not simply another word for authentic power, though they are inseparable. 

While authentic power arises from aligning your personality with your soul, reverence allows you to experience life without cruelty, to see its inherent worth even when disempowered. It transforms how you perceive people, plants, animals, and even the most ordinary moments.

At its heart, this Soul Feast reveals that love and reverence are what’s truly real. When we move beyond personality-to-personality reactions into soul-to-soul connections, we begin to live with awe, compassion, and a deeper recognition of life’s uniqueness.

What You’ll Discover in This Soul Feast:

  • (00:00) — A New World Emerging: Why humanity is moving beyond external power and into soul-based authentic power.
  • (05:48) — Personality vs. Soul Connections: How to recognize the difference between surface-level attraction/repulsion and meaningful soul-to-soul connection.
  • (09:13) — Seeing the Soul in Others: Why acknowledging both frightened and loving parts in yourself helps you honor them in others.
  • (11:46) — Even Hitler Had a Soul: What extreme examples of human shadow teach us about complexity and hidden loving parts.
  • (14:56) — From Judgment to Reverence: How shifting from personality-to-personality judgments to soul awareness creates reverence for life.
  • (18:13) — Why Reverence Matters: Why life without reverence becomes destructive—and how reverence restores compassion and meaning.

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge:

This week, take out your Soul Notebook and jot down the insights, phrases, or ideas from this episode that resonated most deeply with you. Each day, reflect on them: Did you experience moments of reverence in your interactions – with people, animals, or even simple experiences? Where did you miss the opportunity to see the preciousness of life? At the end of the week, review your reflections to see how reverence is beginning to transform your awareness.
